name: Explain request - code explanation
description: explain_action matches a request that asks for an explanation of code
query: Can you explain what this Python function does and why it uses a deque here?

name: Fix request - bug repair
description: fix_action matches a request that asks to repair a bug
query: This Go test keeps failing, can you fix the bug in the authentication middleware?

name: Generate request - new code
description: generate_action matches a request that asks to write new code
query: Write a Python script that counts how many times each word appears in a text file

name: Other request - no action
description: A message that names no action should not trigger any action decision
query: Sounds good, thanks for the help.

name: Math request - keep domain routing
description: A non-coding math question should keep the math domain decision even if the action classifier reads it as explain
query: What is the derivative of x squared with respect to x?

name: Biology request - keep domain routing
description: A non-coding biology question should keep the biology domain decision even if the action classifier reads it as explain
